title: Staff Software Engineer, Supply Chain Management Technology (all genders)
description: <h2>About the role: What's in the Box</h2> <p>As a Staff Engineer in our Supply Chain Management organization, you will be responsible for defining, securing, and implementing technical solutions for business problems. You will play a critical role as our systems scale to handle a jump from 1.2 million to over 2.4 million produced boxes per week due to recent software product consolidation. You will look after speeding up development, decision-making, and problem-solving. You will work with our neighboring teams to ensure that our efforts aim to achieve a clearer architecture and boundaries between tech teams to support autonomy. You will communicate directly with our business stakeholders and multiple tech teams supporting local markets. You will report to the Director of Engineering in the Production tribe. Teamarbeit und Wissenstransfer: Du identifizierst übergeordnete Themen, teilst relevante Kunden- und Marktkenntnisse im Team und unterstützt dabei, Standards und Arbeitsweisen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Was du mitbringst Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Account Management in der digitalen Medienbranche oder im Agenturumfeld mit und hast bereits größere oder komplexere Kunden eigenständig betreut. B2B-Verständnis: Du kannst dich schnell in unterschiedliche Geschäftsmodelle, Zielgruppen und Herausforderungen im B2B-Umfeld hineindenken und daraus relevante Kommunikations- und Mediaanforderungen ableiten. Digital-Marketing-Know-how: Du verfügst über fundiertes Verständnis für digitale Kampagnen und kennst relevante Mechanismen von Programmatic Advertising, Paid Social und Performance Marketing. Berührungspunkte mit weiteren digitalen Kanälen sind ein Plus. Strategische Beratungskompetenz: Du denkst über einzelne Kampagnen hinaus, erkennst Zusammenhänge und Potenziale und kannst Kunden auch auf strategischer Ebene beraten und weiterentwickeln. Kundenverständnis: Du hast ein feines Gespür dafür, was Kunden wirklich brauchen, kannst auch unausgesprochene Anforderungen erkennen und bringst unterschiedliche Interessen zu tragfähigen Lösungen zusammen. Sicheres Stakeholdermanagement: Du bewegst dich souverän zwischen operativen Ansprechpartner, Entscheider und verschiedenen internen sowie externen Schnittstellen. Verhandlungsstärke: Du kannst Positionen klar vertreten, Nachverhandlungen professionell führen und auch in anspruchsvolleren Situationen verbindlich und lösungsorientiert bleiben. Projektmanagement: Du steuerst komplexe Projekte strukturiert, setzt Prioritäten eigenständig und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kampagnen und Stakeholdern den Überblick. Analytisches Verständnis: Du kannst KPIs und Kampagnenergebnisse sicher einordnen und daraus konkrete Empfehlungen und nächste Schritte ableiten. Präsentations- und Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln, überzeugende Präsentationen erstellen und dich sicher auf unterschiedlichen Hierarchieebenen bewegen. Sprachkompetenz: Du kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch und kannst dich auch auf Englisch professionell verständigen. Was uns besonders macht Wir bei emetriq sind ein Team aus Experten, die gemeinsam wachsen und das Unternehmen voranbringen möchten. Unsere Arbeit basiert auf Vertrauen, Agilität, Selbstorganisation und Eigenverantwortung – ohne starre Hierarchien, aber mit klaren Entwicklungsperspektiven. Mut zur Veränderung, Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit prägen unsere Kultur. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Leidenschaft für Daten und Innovation teilen. Perfektion ist nicht unser Ziel, aber Engagement und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung – Schritt für Schritt. Unsere Benefits Hybrides Arbeiten: Einmal pro Woche im Büro zur intensiven Zusammenarbeit. An den anderen Tagen entscheidest du selbst, ob du im Büro oder von zuhause arbeitest Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Keine festen Kernzeiten – arbeite nach deinen eigenen Bedürfnissen Mobilität: Unterstützung durch JobRad und das Deutschlandticket Mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp : Anonyme, kostenlose Unterstützung durch Psycholog:innen Vergünstigungen: Telekom-Produkte zu attraktiven Konditionen und eine Benefit-Card ohne Zuzahlung Teamgeist und Events: Von Workshops und Strategietagen bis hin zu Sport-Events und Feierabendtreffen auf unserer Dachterrasse Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke, Siebträgermaschine, Snacks und eine Dachterrasse mit Aussicht Klingt das nach deinem nächsten Schritt? description: Bei Efficio sind wir mehr als nur eine Unternehmensberatung: Wir sind ein Team engagierter Expertinnen und Experten mit dem gemeinsamen Ziel, Einkaufs- und Supply-Chain-Abteilungen nachhaltig zu transformieren. Unsere Mission ist es, durch innovative Lösungen und fundierte Branchenkenntnisse nachhaltigen und messbaren Mehrwert für unsere Klienten zu schaffen. Werde Teil eines dynamischen Umfelds, in dem Deine Fähigkeiten und Ideen einen echten Unterschied machen. Efficio ist die weltweit größte spezialisierte Unternehmensberatung für Einkauf und Supply Chain mit Standorten in Europa, Nordamerika und dem Nahen Osten. Unser diverses Team besteht aus mehr als 1.000 Mitarbeitenden aus über 60 Nationen, die mehr als 40 Sprachen sprechen – und wir wachsen weiterhin stark! Für unser Büro in Düsseldorf suchen wir Verstärkung für unser wachsendes Team von über 50 Mitarbeitenden. Unsere Beraterinnen und Berater in Düsseldorf unterstützen Klienten sowohl in Deutschland als auch europaweit und haben darüber hinaus die Möglichkeit, global tätig zu sein. Dabei bieten wir unseren Klienten flexible Unterstützung – von kurzfristigen Potenzialanalysen über die schnelle Realisierung von Einsparungen bis hin zu langfristigen Partnerschaften, mit dem Ziel, nachhaltigen und messbaren Mehrwert zu schaffen. Als Senior Consultant (SC) übernimmst Du die vollständige Verantwortung für komplexe Workstreams oder mehrere kleinere Workstreams und wirst dabei von Junior Consultants unterstützt. Du wirst sowohl intern als auch von unseren Klienten als Fachexpertin bzw. Fachexperte (Subject Matter Expert, SME) wahrgenommen und übernimmst unter anderem folgende Aufgaben: Eigenständige Steuerung komplexer Workstreams oder mehrerer kleinerer Workstreams, häufig mit Unterstützung durch Junior Consultants Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Junior Consultants auf Projekten sowie Sicherstellung der Anwendung der Efficio-Methoden und -Prozesse Durchführung und Steuerung komplexer Analysen, auch bei schwer zugänglichen Daten, sowie Entwicklung fundierter Schlussfolgerungen und kreativer Lösungsempfehlungen auf Basis Deiner Expertise Beratung unserer Klienten und Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung von Lösungen für komplexe Herausforderungen, die nachhaltige Ergebnisse und messbaren Mehrwert erzielen Eigenständiger Aufbau und effektives Management von Beziehungen zu Senior Stakeholdern Planung und Erstellung der relevanten Dokumentation für den eigenen Workstream Mitwirkung am Recruiting-Prozess für potenzielle Junior Consultants Unsere kollaborative und inklusive Unternehmenskultur zeichnet uns aus. Bei Efficio kommen Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Ideen und Perspektiven zusammen, um innovative Lösungen für unsere Klienten zu entwickeln. Daher suchen wir neue Teammitglieder mit ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Empathie und der Fähigkeit, starke Beziehungen aufzubauen und damit unsere Kultur auch während unseres weiteren Wachstums aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir ermutigen unsere Teams, proaktiv neue Ideen einzubringen, bestehende Ansätze zu hinterfragen und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln. Dafür sind ausgeprägtes analytisches Denken und kreative Problemlösungsfähigkeiten ebenso wichtig wie ein sicherer Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint. Wir suchen Teammitglieder, die Freude daran haben und bereits Erfahrung darin mitbringen, komplexe Herausforderungen zu analysieren und zu lösen – entweder aus einer führenden Unternehmensberatung oder einer relevanten Position in der Industrie. Attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sind ein wichtiger Bestandteil unseres Angebots. Wir schätzen daher ambitionierte Persönlichkeiten, die ihre Karriere proaktiv entsprechend ihren Zielen und Interessen gestalten möchten. Um den Anforderungen unserer Klienten gerecht zu werden, setzen wir eine gewisse Reisebereitschaft voraus. Deine persönlichen Präferenzen kannst Du uns gerne bereits im Rahmen Deiner Bewerbung mitteilen. Wir freuen uns außerdem darauf, mehr über weitere Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen zu erfahren, die Du mitbringst. Besonders interessant sind für uns: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Erfahrung in der Managementberatung bei einer führenden Unternehmensberatung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt auf Einkauf und/oder Supply Chain Erfahrung oder ausgeprägtes Interesse in den Bereichen Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Transformation, Supply Chain, Operations, Infrastruktur oder Capital Projects Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Stakeholdern auf Kundenseite Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Problemlösungskompetenz sowie die Fähigkeit, zentrale Fragestellungen zu identifizieren und fundierte Schlussfolgerungen abzuleiten Hohe Detailorientierung und eine ausgeprägte „Hands-on“-Mentalität Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und Führungskompetenz Fähigkeit, bestehende Arbeitsweisen selbstbewusst zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern, Chancen zu erkennen und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die einen echten Mehrwert für unsere Klienten schaffen Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: 1KOMMA5° Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei? Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien. Deine Position Jeden Monat fragen Tausende Haushalte bei uns eine Beratung für Solar, Wärmepumpe oder Heartbeat AI an. Bis zur Unterschrift ist es ein ganz schöner Weg: Inside Sales, über 40 Standorte, Kalender, CRM und jede Menge Übergaben per Hand. Mal läuft die Pipeline richtig gut, mal hakt es an mehreren Stellen gleichzeitig Da setzt du an. Du machst diesen Weg schneller, sauberer und messbar, und du baust dafür selbst: Systeme, Prozesse und Auswertungen, die auch dann noch halten, wenn wir weiter wachsen Du wirst Teil unseres kleinen RevOps-Teams in Growth. Wir sind so etwas wie das Schweizer Taschenmesser im Haus: Mal löschen wir Brände, mal bauen wir Dinge, die dauerhaft laufen. Wir sind über die ganze Customer Journey unterwegs und sitzen mit Sales, Marketing und Tech am Tisch, und die wollen nicht immer dasselbe. Wir halten es pragmatisch. Dazu gehören die Systeme dahinter: die Dashboards, mit denen gesteuert wird, die Prozesse und Automatisierungen, die alles am Laufen halten, und die Daten, auf denen es aufbaut Deine Lösungen baust du selbst, bringst sie in den operativen Betrieb und rollst sie aus. Wo es nötig ist, arbeitest du dabei mit unseren Tech-Teams zusammen Was du konkret machst Steuerung aufbauen: Looker-Dashboards, Alerts und SLAs, mit denen Vertriebsleitungen in der Zentrale und an den Standorten jede Woche arbeiten Übergaben automatisieren: Routing, Terminvergabe, die Übergabe von Inside Sales an die Standorte und den Umgang mit No-Shows und Dubletten AI-Workflows selbst bauen: Prototypen in Windmill oder n8n, die du gemeinsam mit MarTech und Tech live bringst Für saubere Daten sorgen: Felddefinitionen, Pflichtfelder, regelmäßige Datenpflege und Source-of-Truth-Regeln in unserem CRM (Zoho) Piloten sauber aufsetzen: Hypothese, ein bis zwei Standorte, gemessenes Ergebnis und am Ende die Entscheidung, ob ausgerollt wird Einen Backlog an Optimierungsmaßnahmen aufbauen: Call-Transkripte, Pipeline- und Standortdaten werden zu einer priorisierten Liste, was als Nächstes gebaut wird Teams mitnehmen und enablen: Mit Dokumentation, Trainings und Rollouts sorgst du dafür, dass Standortleitungen, Inside Sales und Vertrieb deine Systeme auch nutzen Damit arbeitest du unter anderem: Zoho CRM, Looker, Windmill, n8n, Heyflow, Calendly, Aircall, ActiveCampaign, Telli, Google Workspace Dein Profil Du hast 1-2+ Jahre oder mehr Erfahrung in RevOps, Sales Ops, GTM Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Dort hast du eine Funnel-Kennzahl wirklich verantwortet und nicht nur reported Du weißt, wie ein Sales Funnel funktioniert, von Lead über Qualifizierung, Deal und Angebot bis zum Upsell. Und du weißt, was an jeder Stelle die Conversion und Cycle Time treibt Du hast KPIs, Automatisierungen oder AI-Workflows selbst aufgebaut und live gebracht, etwa mit Windmill, n8n, Make, Python, Claude etc. Und sie werden im Alltag tatsächlich skaliert genutzt Deine Dashboards baust du selbst, in Looker, Power BI, Tableau oder einem ähnlichen Tool. Dass die Daten am Anfang unsauber sind, schreckt dich nicht ab Du kennst dich mit CRM-Systemen aus (Zoho oder ähnliche), vom Datenmodell über Workflows bis zu Integrationen Du arbeitest gern eng mit Tech, Sales und Marketing zusammen und sprichst die Sprache aller drei. Technische Trade-offs übersetzt du in Business-Entscheidungen und kommerzielle Prioritäten in technische Anforderungen, ohne dass jemand vermitteln muss Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch, in Wort und Schrift Das ist ein Plus Du hast schon mit einer Vertriebsorganisation mit Standorten oder Außendienst gearbeitet, nicht nur aus der Zentrale heraus Du hast Lead Management schon praktisch umgesetzt: Scoring, Routing, Nurturing, Terminvergabe etc Du hast erste Agents, z.B. extern Voice AI oder Conversational Agents oder interne Effizienz-Automatisierungen schon live gebracht Du hast Erfahrung mit dem B2C-Geschäft und mit hochpreisigen Produkten, etwa Energie, Solar, Hausmodernisierung oder Automotive Benefits Du hast die Möglichkeit in unseren brandneuen Büros in der Hamburger Innenstadt & Berlin zu arbeiten und hybrid Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzi al , wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien , übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass Ob Citybike oder E-Bike – mit unserem Jobrad-Leasing bleibst du flexibel und bist umweltfreundlich unterwegs Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Your tasks Get CAD ready for rendering: Turn heavy mechanical assemblies from engineering into clean 3D assets that render, animate and run in real time without falling apart. The hardware stands in our workshop, and the next machine is never far behind. Show what is inside: Exploded views, cutaways and assembly animations that explain the mechanics without a technical drawing, so customers understand the tech behind the product. Materials that look real: Build shaders for aluminum, stainless steel, glass, rubber, carbon, plastics, displays and LEDs, so a render reads as the actual object rather than as a render. Scenes, materials and rigs stay organized, so the next project does not start from zero. Motion design in a house style: Titles, typography, transitions, logo animation, and 2D animation for interface elements like animated displays and icons. raw.title: 3D & Motion Designer | Robotics
raw.description:
Your tasks

  • Get CAD ready for rendering: Turn heavy mechanical assemblies from engineering into clean 3D assets that render, animate and run in real time without falling apart. The hardware stands in our workshop, and the next machine is never far behind.
  • Show what is inside: Exploded views, cutaways and assembly animations that explain the mechanics without a technical drawing, so customers understand the tech behind the product.
  • Materials that look real: Build shaders for aluminum, stainless steel, glass, rubber, carbon, plastics, displays and LEDs, so a render reads as the actual object rather than as a render. Scenes, materials and rigs stay organized, so the next project does not start from zero.
  • Motion design in a house style: Titles, typography, transitions, logo animation, and 2D animation for interface elements like animated displays and icons. It should look like us, not like a template pack.
  • Editing and post: Footage from the workshop and tests, mixed with 3D work, becomes what we use on the website, on social, at trade shows and in investor meetings. Editing, grading, sound, subtitles, and a version that fits each channel.
  • Put AI to work: You use AI and generative tools (e.g. comfy) where they actually save time, whether that is concepting, cleanup or upscaling. You keep testing what is new, keep what earns a place in the pipeline, and drop the rest.

Your profile

  • Background: A degree in motion design, animation or media design, or a self taught route with a reel that makes the question pointless.
  • Experience: At least two years of hands on work, whether from an internship, freelance jobs, a studio or your own projects. What the work looks like matters more to us than where it was made.
  • CAD is not new to you: You have opened engineering data before and know roughly what happens when a heavy assembly meets a render engine.
  • Reel: Hard surfaces, metal, glass and light. Even one personal project done properly tells us more than ten client jobs you only assisted on.
  • Tools: Experience in Blender and Cinema 4D, Octane is a plus. After Effects and either Premiere for the cut.
  • How you work: Hands on and fast to a first version. You get things finished instead of perfect, and you notice when a detail stops being worth the hours.
  • Languages: Fluent English. Good German is a real plus.

Why us?

  • Your work is what people see of us: Almost everything the outside world sees of our robots comes out of your hands, and you decide how that looks.
  • Everything under one roof: Labs, workshop and test rigs are in the same Kreuzberg building. The engineer you need is a walk away, not a ticket.
  • Room to get better: Paid learning time and a personal budget for it, projects where something is allowed to not work the first time, and support for portfolio work and conference talks as the company becomes known.
  • Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, home setup, health or food. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about.

Send us a link to your work. Best case it includes something you took from CAD data to a finished render, with a note on how. Skip the cover letter.

Process: Intro call -> Portfolio deep-dive -> Half-day on-site visit with a small design exercise -> Offer.

We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in 3D and motion. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway.

websites, social media campaigns, and localized adaptations across text, design, and video formats.</li> <li>Apply strong conceptual thinking and creative writing skills to craft engaging and written and spoken.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible hybrid working policy (2 days at the office, depending on location);</li> <li>Company pension scheme.</li> <li>Lease bike options / JobRad and 25% subsidy for the Deutschlandticket.</li> <li>Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform.</li> <li>€30 per month - You can use healthy products at attractive deals.</li> <li>Social events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.</li> <li>A reputation for doing good. And we celebrate all of our successes together!</li> <li>The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.</li> <li>Global annual <a href="https://www.deptagency.com/dept-cares-day-2023/">DEPT® Cares Month</a> in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY DEPT®?</strong></p> <p>We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.</p> <p>We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.</p> <p>At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.</p> <p><strong>AI Disclosure</strong>: At DEPT®, we use AI-assisted technology (Metaview) to capture notes and summarize interview conversations, so our interviewers can stay fully focused. title: Mid Market Account Executive - DACH
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:<br></strong>Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers.<strong><br></strong></p> <p>While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €<strong>10k to </strong><strong>€</strong><strong>300k</strong>, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.</p> <p>Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).</p> <p>You should apply if:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world</strong>: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting</strong>: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.</li> <li><strong>You have innate curiosity in how businesses work</strong>: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You are a life-long learner</strong>: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.</li> <li><strong>You build genuine relationships with your customers</strong>: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best</strong>: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li> </ul> <p>In this role you will:</p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li><strong>Own your destiny:</strong> Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for <strong>80-90% net-new logo acquisition</strong> through self-sourced pipeline.</li> <li><strong>Get In Early: </strong>The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Sharpen Your Edge:</strong> Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>Minimum Requirements for the role:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Winning DNA:</strong> Min.18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.</li> <li><strong>Over-achievement:</strong> A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment</li> <li><strong>Strategic Grit:</strong> Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt</li> <li><strong>Native German</strong> language speakers</li> </ul> <p>Advantageous:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Intellectual Curiosity:</strong> You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.</li> <li><strong>A Repeatable Sales Framework:</strong> You don’t rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.</li> <li><strong>A Data-Minded Approach:</strong> You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Continuous Process Iteration:</strong> You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s <a href="https://www.samsara.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information.</p> <p><strong>Fraudulent Employment Offers</strong></p> <p>Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our&nbsp;<a href="https://samsara.com/blog/avoiding-fake-job-offers">blog post here</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. in MSP environments and position the full platform — FlashArray, FlashBlade, Portworx and Everpure Data Intelligence.</li> <li>Build technical credibility with MSP architects, practice leads and CTOs, growing a population of partner-side technical champions.</li> <li>Feed real MSP requirements back into the global MSP programme and Product Management, contributing reusable IP — reference architectures, sizing guides, service blueprints — from live engagements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in pre-sales, solutions architecture or technical leadership, with a demonstrable record of winning partner-led business.</li> <li>Direct experience with MSPs, with a real understanding of how they build, price, operate and sell a managed service.</li> <li>Credible at depth across modern data platform architecture: block, file and object, hybrid and cloud data services, Kubernetes and storage-as-a-service models.</li> <li>Commercial fluency — comfortable discussing consumption economics, TCO and margin with an MSP's finance and practice leadership.</li> <li>Outstanding written, diagrammatic and verbal communication, with the executive presence to move between a CTO conversation and a whiteboard session.</li> <li>Entrepreneurial and ambitious — comfortable building a practice rather than inheriting one.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.</li> <li><strong>Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!</li> <li><strong>Team</strong>: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.</li> </ul> <p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://benefits.everpuredata.com/">http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ </a>for more information.</p> <p><strong>ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:</strong></p> <p>Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at <a ---------- if you’re invited to an interview.</p> <p><strong>OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:</strong></p> <p>We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.</p> <p>Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Werkstudent:in Business Consultancy
description: Über Northwave Unternehmen zu schützen, ist unsere Mission. Bei Northwave verändern 275+ Cyber Security-Spezialist:innen die Art und Weise, wie Unternehmen und Organisationen digitale Sicherheit denken und umsetzen. Mit unserem Hauptsitz in Utrecht, unserem DACH-Headquarter in Leipzig sowie Standorten in Österreich, Schweden und Belgien sind wir europaweit vertreten. Northwave verbindet Expertise im Ethical Hacking mit Erkenntnissen aus der Verhaltenspsychologie und modernstem Security Management auf höchstem Niveau. Wir reagieren nicht nur auf Bedrohungen, sondern erkennen sie frühzeitig. Mit unseren 24/7 Managed Security Services und maßgeschneiderten Lösungen begleiten wir unsere Kund:innen auf ihrem individuellen Weg zu mehr Sicherheit. Wenn Du Teil von Northwave wirst, arbeitest Du in einem Umfeld, in dem Innovation zu echten Ergebnissen führt. Bei uns entwickelst Du Deine Expertise weiter und trägst aktiv dazu bei, die Zukunft der digitalen Sicherheit in unterschiedlichsten Branchen mitzugestalten. Deine Mission Du willst nicht einfach nur Akten wälzen, sondern die echte Welt der strategischen Management- und IT-Beratung hautnah kennenlernen? Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) in unserem Business Security Consulting Team arbeitest du direkt mit unserem Head of Consultancy DACH zusammen.  Deine Mission ist es, die Brücke zwischen strategischen Geschäftszielen und den Herausforderungen der Cybersecurity zu schlagen. Du musst an Tag 1 kein technischer Deep-Dive-Experte sein – was für uns zählt, ist dein Drive, dein analytischer Verstand und dein Verständnis für Geschäftsmodelle.  Deine Aufgaben:   Sparringspartner in Training: Du unterstützt den Head of Consultancy direkt im strategischen Tagesgeschäft und bei der Steuerung des DACH-Beratungsgeschäfts.  Consulting hautnah: Du begleitest Kundenprojekte in den Bereichen Cybersecurity-Strategie, Risikomanagement und Compliance (z.B. NIS2, CRA, ISO 27001) und lernst das Handwerkszeug der Top-Beratung von der Pike auf.  Business & Cyber: Du analysierst Geschäftsmodelle, bereitest Marktrecherchen auf und hilfst dabei, abstrakte Bedrohungen in pragmatische, wertschöpfende Strategien für das C-Level zu übersetzen.  Content Creation: Du erstellst Management-Präsentationen, Reports und Workshop-Materialien, die komplexe Sachverhalte auf den Punkt bringen.   Das erwartet Dich bei uns Das Wichtigste zuerst: Dein Studium steht an erster Stelle. Daher findet die  Abstimmung deiner Arbeitszeiten  immer im Austausch mit dir und unter Berücksichtigung deines Semesterplans statt. Zudem bieten wir dir einen  attraktiven Stundenlohn  (über Mindestlohn) und  sechs Wochen Urlaub  im Jahr. Unser Büro ist mit  Apple Geräten ,  höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen  und einem stets mit  kühlen Getränken gefüllten Kühlschrank ausgestattet.  Ach ja, und es gibt regelmäßig  Merch  im Northwave Design, sowie  Kuchen und niederländische  Karamellwaffeln . Bei Northwave bist du Teil eines  internationalen Teams  aus Security-Enthusiat:innen, die gerne ihr Wissen teilen und sich über Unterstützung z.B. beim Firmenlauf oder dem Pub Quiz freuen. In Deutschland befinden wir uns noch im Aufbau -  deine Chance  also, mitzugestalten. Lust auf Beratung: Du hast den absoluten Willen, die Consulting-Welt zu erobern und bist bereit, dich mit Hands-on-Mentalität in neue, komplexe Themenstellungen einzuarbeiten.  Mindset & Drive: Begeisterungsfähigkeit, grenzenlose Neugier und ein extrem hoher Lernwille sind für dich selbstverständlich.  Business First: Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes betriebswirtschaftliches Denken. Ein echtes Interesse für Cybersecurity ist Pflicht – genauso wichtig ist aber das Verständnis dafür, dass IT-Sicherheit immer auch einen "Business Value" liefern muss.  Background: Eingeschrieben an einer Hochschule? Check. Was genau du studierst (von Kunstgeschichte bis Informatik), ist uns dabei völlig egal. Wir suchen keine reinen Theorie-Experten, sondern Macher mit Hands-on-Mentalität und einem messerscharfen Verstand.  Skills: Du bringst eine strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit.  Perspektive: Du wirst Teil eines internationalen Teams von Cybersecurity-Enthusiasten. Da unsere deutsche Organisation kontinuierlich wächst, hast du die einmalige Chance, unsere Zukunft mitzugestalten und dich langfristig bei uns weiterzuentwickeln.    Interessiert? Du bist Dir noch nicht ganz sicher? Dann schau Dir an, wie das Arbeiten bei Northwave aussieht: Karriere bei Northwave . Wenn Du bereit bist, mit uns die digitale Zukunft sicherer zu machen, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Your tasks Shape the hardware identity: Define how our humanoids look and feel: proportions, surfaces, overall silhouette. You take the design direction we already have and carry it through to physical systems that actually ship. Design for passive safety first: Safety sits in the geometry from the first sketch. Integrate complex systems: Package the internals (sensors, cameras, cooling, connectors, cable routing) so the technical parts look intended. Physical human machine interaction: Design status signals, touchpoints and small physical cues that tell the people working next to the robot what it is doing and what comes next. Build the ecosystem around the robot: Extend the design language to charging docks, transport cases, maintenance gear and packaging. From model to CAD: You build physical models fast, see what holds up, and change them until they do. Then you do the surfacing and hand over CAD that engineering can build from directly. Materials and processes: Select finishes, review physical samples, and work suppliers on feasibility, cost and lead times. You are willing to try materials that are not standard and to bring in specialized external labs. Your profile Background: A degree in industrial or product design, or an engineering degree where the design side is clearly the stronger half. Experience: Around five years or more designing physical products, in house or at a studio. Robotics, medical devices, lab and industrial equipment, mobility, or another field where the hardware has to hold up in front of people. Small series: You have worked on products built in the hundreds rather than the millions, and know how much that changes what a shape can be. Safety and regulation: You have designed under mechanical safety requirements before, so guarding, clearances and contact safety are familiar territory rather than a new topic. Tools: Surface modeling in Rhino, Onshape, SolidWorks or Fusion, plus 3D printing and enough workshop practice to build your own models. Working with engineers: You read mechanical drawings, keep up in technical discussions, and can explain why a design decision matters. Languages: Fluent English. title: Projektmanager:in Social Media & Paid Ads (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind fravio, eine junge, schnell wachsende Social Media Agency mit flachen Hierarchien und großen Ambitionen aus Köln. Unser Team arbeitet mit Brands wie Wolt, Miles, XING und Vodafone sowie den relevantesten Creators Deutschlands zusammen. Unser Fokus: Innovative Social-Konzepte, skalierbare Influencer-Kampagnen und Street Generated Content (SGC). Wir suchen jemanden, der die Brücke zwischen organischem Content und Paid Performance schlägt und beides operativ auf Top-Niveau umsetzt. Aufgaben Deine Rolle Als Projektmanager:in Social Media & Paid Ads bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen Content und Performance. Du steuerst Ad-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok eigenverantwortlich, bewertest organischen Content auf sein Paid-Potenzial und sorgst dafür, dass aus Creator-Content messbare Ergebnisse werden. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Creators, Produktionen und unseren Kunden zusammen. Deine Aufgaben Ad-Management: Du planst, schaltest und optimierst Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, inklusive Dark Ads und Spark Ads, für verschiedene Märkte mit klarem B2C-Fokus. Content-Bewertung: Du bewertest organischen Content strategisch und identifizierst, welche Assets sich für die Übersetzung in Paid Ads eignen. Creator-Koordination: Du kommunizierst mit kleineren Creators, buchst größere Creators für Ad-Produktionen, prüfst Skripte und stimmst dich mit Produktionen ab. Performance-Verständnis: Du weißt, was ein Pixel ist, verstehst, wie Landingpages konvertieren, und leitest aus Kampagnendaten konkrete Optimierungen ab. Account-Strategie: Du entwickelst perspektivisch organische Channels für Kunden und denkst Accountaufbau, Content-Strategie und Paid immer zusammen. Reporting: Du erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und übersetzt Zahlen in Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit Erfahrung: Mindestens 2-3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Social Media Advertising oder Performance Marketing, idealerweise auf Agenturseite. Plattform-Expertise: Du kennst die Ad-Manager von Meta und TikTok in- und auswendig und weißt, wie Dark Ads und Spark Ads funktionieren. Content-Gespür: Du bist nicht nur Performance-Nerd, sondern verstehst auch, was organisch auf Social Media funktioniert, und kannst Content qualitativ bewerten. Regionaler Fokus: Du kommst aus dem Raum Köln/Umgebung, da dir die regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team im Office (Hybrid-Modell) wichtig ist. Analytik & Struktur: KPIs wie CPM, CTR, ROAS und Conversion-Rates sind dein Werkzeugkasten, du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst mehrere Kampagnen parallel im Blick. Sprache: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und flüssiges Englisch, da du auch mit internationalen Stakeholdern arbeitest. Benefits Was dich bei uns erwartet Echte Verantwortung: Du steuerst Ad-Budgets für einen der spannendsten Accounts Deutschlands eigenverantwortlich. Growth: Raum für deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung in Richtung Senior oder Unit-Verantwortung. Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten & faires Hybrid-Modell (Home Office & Office-Tage). Vibe: Ein junges, ehrgeiziges Team, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege. Equipment & Perks: MacBook, modernes Office im Herzen von Köln, Jobticket und regelmäßige Teamevents. About dnl

dnl is a fast-growing AI startup building AI-first solutions for auditing. Our software automates disclosure checklists and other document-heavy audit work for audit firms and corporate clients, so professionals can spend their time on judgment instead of manual checking. The role

You co-decide which audit problems we solve next, design how our platform addresses them, and grow the value dnl contributes to every engagement. This role is for auditors, not career product managers: audit experience is required, product management experience is not.

You know first-hand where audits lose time, where risks are missed and which workarounds teams rely on. You don't need to code. You need to think in structured processes and want to build the tools you always wished you had. You work closely with our engineering and AI team, our customers and the management team.

  • Identify the biggest pain points across the audit process - from planning to reporting – and turn them into new product areas beyond the current setup

  • Translate accounting and auditing standards (IFRS, HGB, ISA, IDW PS) into clear, software-executable logic, decision trees and workflows

description: Are you prepared to fuel the growth of an exciting scale-up that's transforming the logistics industry? These companies have hundreds of trucks loading and unloading every month, and our SaaS platform helps them orchestrate that whole process. Peripass is a high-impact SaaS platform used in international enterprise environments. Want to be part of this adventure? As an Account Executive Germany within the Sales Team, you will have a front-row seat to the growth of an international SaaS scale-up and play a key role in expanding our presence in the German market. Own the full sales cycle: You will be responsible for selling our SaaS solution and independently managing qualified sales opportunities from initial engagement through signed contract. This includes identifying and qualifying prospects, conducting discovery conversations, developing business cases, managing stakeholders, negotiating and closing deals. Build our presence in Germany: Identify target accounts and create new business opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting and personalised outreach across relevant industries. Work closely with our BDR team to open conversations with new prospects and build awareness of Peripass in the German market. Pipeline momentum and sales velocity: Proactively collaborate with internal stakeholders and customer champions to maintain momentum, reduce sales cycles, and improve win rates. title: ICT Outsourcing Manager (f/m/x)
description: About lemon.markets 🍋 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers. lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months. As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market. Your Mission As our ICT Outsourcing Manager , you strengthen how lemon.markets manages and governs external technology services, outsourcing arrangements, and third-party risk in a regulated environment. Sitting at the intersection of Technology, Compliance, Operations, and partner governance, this role helps ensure that our provider landscape is transparent, well-documented, risk-based, and operationally under control. Over the next 6–12 months, your main focus will be to improve our third-party management process adding automation and AI supported assessments across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing relationships. You will help turn recurring governance work into reliable operating routines, from assessments and reporting to escalations and evidence gathering. This is a hands-on role with real impact, especially for someone who enjoys creating structure, driving follow-up, and continuously improving operational processes. In this role you will: Act as the first line competence centre for ICT outsourcing and third-party governance topics, working across Technology, Compliance, Operations, business owners, and external partners to ensure risks and responsibilities are transparent and well managed. Own the operational execution of our ICT third-party and outsourcing governance framework across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing arrangements, so that key relationships are assessed, documented, and monitored in line with regulatory expectations. Drive risk assessments, due diligence processes, and recurring reviews for new and existing third parties, coordinating relevant stakeholders and turning findings into clear actions, decisions, and follow-ups. Maintain and improve the outsourcing register, governance documentation, and supporting evidence base, creating the level of clarity and traceability needed for internal stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and partners. raw.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

 

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

 

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

 

Your Mission

As our ICT Outsourcing Manager, you strengthen how lemon.markets manages and governs external technology services, outsourcing arrangements, and third-party risk in a regulated environment. Sitting at the intersection of Technology, Compliance, Operations, and partner governance, this role helps ensure that our provider landscape is transparent, well-documented, risk-based, and operationally under control. Over the next 6–12 months, your main focus will be to improve our third-party management process adding automation and AI supported assessments across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing relationships. You will help turn recurring governance work into reliable operating routines, from assessments and reporting to escalations and evidence gathering. This is a hands-on role with real impact, especially for someone who enjoys creating structure, driving follow-up, and continuously improving operational processes.

In this role you will:

  • Act as the first line competence centre for ICT outsourcing and third-party governance topics, working across Technology, Compliance, Operations, business owners, and external partners to ensure risks and responsibilities are transparent and well managed.

  • Own the operational execution of our ICT third-party and outsourcing governance framework across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing arrangements, so that key relationships are assessed, documented, and monitored in line with regulatory expectations.

  • Drive risk assessments, due diligence processes, and recurring reviews for new and existing third parties, coordinating relevant stakeholders and turning findings into clear actions, decisions, and follow-ups.

  • Maintain and improve the outsourcing register, governance documentation, and supporting evidence base, creating the level of clarity and traceability needed for internal stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and partners.

  • Prepare, structure, and run governance and review routines, including reporting, meeting preparation, escalation tracking, and action follow-up, to make third-party oversight more consistent, measurable, and decision-useful.

  • Identify and advance process improvements, standardisation opportunities, and selective AI-supported automation in recurring third-party management workflows, helping the function become more scalable and effective over time.

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • Bring hands-on experience in ICT outsourcing, third-party management, vendor risk, IT governance, compliance-related operations, or a similar function in a regulated environment.

  • Have a solid understanding of how external providers and outsourcing relationships are governed, documented, and monitored from a risk and compliance perspective.

  • Are comfortable working with risk assessments, service levels, control evidence, recurring reporting, and cross-functional governance routines.

  • Have enough technical affinity to understand IT services, security-related topics, incidents, and operational dependencies without needing to be a security engineer.

  • Work in a highly structured and reliable way, with strong follow-up discipline, good judgment, and the ability to keep multiple stakeholders aligned.

  • Communicate confidently in German and English, and enjoy making complex governance topics clear, practical, and actionable.

 

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more / leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

title: Research Engineer
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is a quantitative trading firm at the forefront of technological innovation. We build and deploy cutting-edge systems within one of the world’s most advanced computing environments to power our global trading operations. Our non-siloed, collaborative coding environment empowers talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you'll be challenged to solve the most complex problems in trading alongside many of the brightest minds in the field.</p> <p>We are seeking highly motivated and skilled <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Research Engineers</span> who will work very closely with our Algo Developer (Quant Research) trading teams. These roles require exceptional programming fundamentals, a strong user focus, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with constantly evolving requirements. Multitasking and context switching are inherent aspects of this role, through which you will gain insight into the ideation and execution of some of the world's most sophisticated trading strategies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Research Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. Examples include:</p> <ul> <li>Designing highly customized quantitative systems that enable Algo Developers to easily express and backtest new predictive signals.</li> <li>Building world-class research tooling to speed up Algo Developers’ research iteration.</li> <li>Aiding the development and deployment of very large deep learning models for HRT’s live trading.</li> <li>Improving HRT’s monetization systems which turn our predictions into profitable trades.</li> <li>Evaluating sim vs. live differences to improve the fidelity of our simulations.</li> <li>Building systems to monitor and manage live trading.</li> <li>Specializing in specific time horizons, from high frequency trading to mid-to-low frequency hedge fund-style strategies.</li> <li>Working across a very wide variety of asset classes (from equities to fixed income to options) and regions (from North America to Asia Pacific) – you’ll interact with markets across the world!</li> </ul> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, develop, and maintain robust, performant, and scalable software systems.</li> <li>Optimize existing codebases for performance, reliability, and efficiency.</li> <li>Debug complex issues across distributed systems in a time-sensitive environment.</li> <li>Optimize both the mechanics and ergonomics of Algo Developer research workflows; this requires developing a deep intuition for research methodologies.</li> <li>Balance the short term goals of individual trading teams with the longer term goals of HRT’s generalized trading platforms across trading teams. Because we don’t work in a pod environment, REs on different trading teams are expected to share technology and ideas.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. If you are currently pursuing your Bachelor's degree, please apply to our Campus/New Grad opportunities.</li> <li>Previous experience at a top-tier finance <em>or</em> technology company with an excellent track record of rapid advancement and superlative reviews.</li> <li>Experience with supporting internal users is preferred; bonus if you have <em>real</em> hands-on experience with quant research and/or ML/Deep Learning platforms.</li> <li>Experience with python numerical, ML and data-oriented libraries is a big plus (e.g. pandas, scikit, pytorch, etc.)</li> <li>Candidates should be prepared for technical interviews in either Python or C++. No “smart jerks” at HRT.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design principles.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>HRT ships every day. The ability to thoughtfully, methodically, and reliably deploy new software and features is a critical skill.&nbsp;</li> <li>If you have management experience, that’s always a bonus – but even so, expect to code!</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). Kraken Utilities Our tech platform ‘Kraken’ is already licensed to support 90 million customer accounts globally, and we aim to serve 100 million by 2027. Kraken is the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications. We’re now charging the Kraken platform to other utility industries (Water and Broadband) and have created a new team called - Kraken Utilities. The Kraken Utilities team is in a very exciting growth phase, and has already signed six key clients: Severn Trent, Leep, Portsmouth Water, Essential Energy, TalkTalk, and Cuckoo. The UK utilities market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential. Help build and scale the Kraken utilities team by embedding an engineering, problem solving, and customer-first culture. Architect & develop new components of the Kraken platform to serve other utilities. We have a lot of challenging problems to solve as we work to improve the utilities industry. There's a great opportunity for disruption in the UK water and broadband markets. The landscape is changing as we move to more dis-aggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism and smarter technology. title: Key Account Executive - UK
description: As Marqeta’s Key Account Executive based in London , you will be passionate about scaling the success of our business in Europe. The team at Marqeta focuses on the largest and most impactful commercial opportunities in Marqeta’s evolving business. These customers include established brands, fintech innovators and labour / retail marketplaces, all looking for solutions to launch, scale and continuously evolve their financial products and services. Key to this role is an ability to understand Marqeta's technology and how it brings value to the market, expertly communicate its benefits, and win the trust of the key stakeholders across revenue growth, product and technology teams of our potential partners. We're looking for a self-motivated, experienced solution seller, who is eager to further deepen their knowledge of embedded finance and possesses the business judgment and sales acumen to vet opportunities and close deals. In this role you will spend the first 3 months learning the ins and outs of Marqeta and our customers and our programme management capabilities, supporting Team Leads on strategic projects, and building a sales pipeline. Additionally, you will need to understand the process of selling a complex platform technology and be able to communicate technical and product benefits to both sophisticated and unsophisticated buyers. PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us! Qualify leads and prioritize the right opportunities: Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects by identifying their needs and requirements, responding to requests for information and proposals, and vetting them against our current and future product offering. Run a Sales Process end to end: Manage real customer opportunities through a sales process, from initial engagement to scoping to final contract negotiations. Contracting: Work with our Legal team as required to shepherd opportunities through the contracting process, including negotiation and execution. Know the Tech: Quickly get up to speed on Marqeta's technical and programme management capabilities, the unique features and customer benefits our platform offers and how to speak with confidence, knowledge and credibility about what we bring to our customers and prospects. Sell the partnership vision: Work with internal SMEs to identify and develop solutions for prospects who are trying to understand what makes Marqeta’s platform and service offering so exceptional and differentiated. Who You Are 10+ years of experience in sales and/or strategic business development roles; payments, investment banking and strategic consulting backgrounds preferred but not required. Bachelor’s Degree or comparable experience required. Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem and card issuing is crucial, with bonus points for having worked in a regulated programme manager offering full stack solutions to customers. Strong familiarity and ease with the fintech ecosystem, B2B technology applications and how technology platforms serve customer businesses. Financial Acumen. The payments business and caliber of customer relationships necessitates complex deal structures and financial modelling. We’re looking for an individual who is comfortable and capable of evaluating and modeling customer proposals and resulting contract financial models. Confidence in serving as the face of Marqeta for prospective customers and partners who may comprise C-suite executives and senior leadership members. Ability to prioritize, manage, and deliver on multiple projects simultaneously; highly motivated and able to work against aggressive schedules. Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to work cross-functionally to deliver on the customer’s needs. Superior communication skills (interpersonal, verbal, email, and presentation) with the ability to successfully orchestrate the sales process by managing the time and resources of the team and specialist partners. Positive attitude, team player, adaptable, resourceful, and self-starter who is able to work independently. Recruiter for this role Lou Devlin - Linkedin Profile (no agencies please!) Typical Process Application Submission Recruiter video call Hiring manager video call Virtual “Onsite” consisting of 2 x 45 min calls Presentation Round to team Offer! Compensation and Benefits Premium Private Medical and Dental coverage Generous time off program with additional “Floating Holiday days” Retirement savings program with company contribution Equity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase Program Monthly stipend to support our remote work model Annual development stipend to support our people's growth and development Family-forming benefits and up to 20 weeks of Parental Leave Wellbeing programs i.e. Modern Health, HealthKick and much more… About Marqeta Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all. Marqeta’s Values – Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do. – Do What's Right: Knowing businesses and livelihoods depend on us, we pursue solutions that disrupt responsibly and deliver high-quality results that our customers count on. We own our work from start to finish. – Simplify and Innovate: We approach challenges with curiosity and take smart risks. Innovation comes from finding better, simpler ways to achieve extraordinary outcomes. – Win as a Team: We succeed together by embracing diverse perspectives and pushing each other to raise the bar. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: About Cinder Cinder is the mission-critical infrastructure that keeps the world's most important digital platforms true to what they stand for. The internet has always been abused by bad actors, and AI is making it exponentially worse, driving fraud, abuse, and manipulation at a scale and speed no human team can fight alone. Cinder gives platforms one command center to fight back: to write and enforce policy, deploy AI agents against abuse in real time, investigate threats, file NCMEC reports, and prove their safety programs are working. Our customers are some of the largest internet platforms in the world. The decisions made in our software directly determine what stays up, what comes down, and how users are treated. We're a small, fast-moving team backed by Accel and Y Combinator. We care about being intentional, direct, and deeply focused on solving real customer problems. Why this role Once a deal closes, you're the technical owner on the ground. You're the escalation point for the customer, working closely with their CSM and Agent Product Manager (agent PM), and the first line of engineering defense when something isn't working the way they expect. For some customers, "close" means embedded. You're effectively part of their engineering team, in their Slack, on their calls, building alongside them. The platforms you'd be embedded with have hundreds of millions of users between them. When you fix something, it's not hypothetical. It's live, that day. What you'd actually work on Shape and prove the solution. Work directly with customers to understand their problems, identify the right use cases, and build proofs of concept that demonstrate value and de-risk the path to production. Own deployments end to end. Take the technical work from scoping and system design through implementation, rollout, and adoption — partnering with the CSM while owning the engineering plan. Build the last mile. Connect Cinder to each customer’s stack through APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, custom workflows, and production-quality code where configuration isn’t enough. Enable customer teams. Run technical workshops, document what you build, and give customers the knowledge and tools to operate successfully without us in the room. Turn fieldwork into product leverage. Solve issues in the systems you ship, identify patterns across customers, and turn those lessons into reusable tools and improvements to the core product. Own on-call for customers when system downtime means moderation stops. What we're looking for 4-8 years as a software engineer, solutions engineer, or in a similar role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Solid Python fundamentals. You can read, debug, and extend backend code without hand-holding. Comfortability with SQL, Typescript, React, and GraphQL. Real experience owning implementation, not just scoping it. You've configured or customized a product for a specific customer and shipped something that changed what that customer could actually do. You are exceptionally comfortable with ambiguity and repeatedly take initiative — you thrive when dropped into unfamiliar situations, learning quickly, and finding ways to deliver value. No degree requirement. We care about what you can build, not where you learned to build it. Bootcamp grads are welcome. Nice to have Understanding of trust & safety or safety operations, either firsthand (you've worked in it) or through a specialized background — a T&S-focused master's, for example — that gives you real fluency, not just familiarity. Consulting experience where you turned a client's ambiguous ask into a working solution. Familiarity with React Query or Strawberry specifically. Experience being embedded with a customer or client team, rather than working at arm's length through tickets. Location & Benefits Our team is based in London and we believe that in-person collaboration is important. We offer medical and dental insurance benefits through Allianz Global. We hold at least two all-company events per year. We offer paid lunch when our team is in-person. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming (FBG) is seeking a&nbsp;<strong>Staff Platform Engineer</strong> to join our Platform Engineering team based in the UK or Ireland. This position plays a critical role within the EMEA Platform Engineering organisation, partnering closely with teams across the UK, Ireland, and United States to build and operate the platforms that power Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming’s global software ecosystem.<br><br>As a Staff Engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, leading complex technical initiatives across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, and internal developer tooling. You will influence platform architecture, define standards and best practices, and act as a force multiplier for engineering teams by improving reliability, scalability, and developer productivity.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help drive technical design and delivery of core platform capabilities spanning cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, Observability, CI/CD systems, and developer tooling</li> <li>Architect, build, and operate cloud-native platforms on AWS with a focus on reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency</li> <li>Lead the evolution of CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-based workflows.</li> <li>Build and maintain internal platform services and tooling that improve developer experience and delivery velocity</li> <li>Continue to drive Infrastructure as Code and automation practices across teams</li> <li>Partner with application teams to unblock delivery and align platform capabilities with developer needs</li> <li>Participate in and/or lead complex, cross-team initiatives and provide technical clarity in ambiguous problem spaces</li> <li>Improve operational excellence through observability, automation, and incident response.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and participate in on-call rotations</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or software engineering</li> <li>Proficiency with Python and Java. Familiarity with Kotlin, Go a plus</li> <li>Deep Kubernetes and container orchestration knowledge</li> <li>Proven CI/CD and GitOps experience</li> <li>Infrastructure as Code expertise (Terraform)</li> <li>Strong AWS and cloud-native experience</li> <li>Experience operating distributed, high-availability systems</li> <li>Ability to influence without authority and communicate effectively across regions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with internal developer platforms or portals</li> <li>FinOps or cloud cost management experience</li> <li>Regulated or high-availability environment experience</li> <li>Backend development experience</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Salary Range&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>£121,200 – £151,200 (London)<br>(Salary is determined by location and may vary based on geography)</p> <p><strong>Why Platform Engineering at FBG</strong></p> <p>Platform Engineering at FBG operates with a product-first mindset. Our mission is to empower developers with reliable, scalable, and intuitive platforms that accelerate innovation and delivery.</p> <p><strong>Working Across Regions</strong></p> <p>This role operates in a globally distributed environment, working closely with teams across the UK, Ireland, and the United States. Strong communication, time zone coordination, and shared ownership are essential for success.</p> <p><strong>Not sure if you check every box?</strong></p> <p>We believe great engineers come from all kinds of backgrounds. We value <strong>impact, technical leadership, and a growth mindset</strong>&nbsp;just as much as specific tool experience.</p> <p>Unfortunately, we do not offer sponsorship and you do need to be living in the UK or Ireland to apply.</p> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>For information about our benefits, please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£111,100</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£138,600 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our&nbsp;<a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

and container technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Proven ability to take ownership of large technical initiatives from architecture through production.</li> <li>Commitment to
