title: Senior Treasury Specialist
description: <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.</p> <p class="p1">Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <h3 class="p1">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p class="p1">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <h3 class="p1">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.</p> <p class="p1">What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.</p> <p class="p1">Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.</p> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Role Summary</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Treasury Specialist will support Firmus’ treasury operations across debt facilities, hedging, cash management, bank guarantees, intercompany funding, reporting, controls, and treasury systems implementation.</p> <p>This role is responsible for helping build scalable treasury processes as Firmus grows, ensuring treasury activity is accurately captured, controlled, reported, and aligned with financing, accounting, compliance, and operational requirements.</p> <ul> <li>Debt facility administration, including ongoing management of monthly compliance processes for GPU backed asset financings.</li> <li>FX and interest rate hedging, including confirmation processes, FX and interest rate settlements, hedge accounting support, valuations, and effectiveness testing inputs.</li> <li>Cash management and investments, including short-term liquidity planning, consolidated cash reporting, investments and counterparty exposure monitoring.</li> <li>Treasury systems and automation, including implementation of a treasury management system, automated bank feeds, straight-through processing, and improved treasury controls.</li> </ul> <p>You will work closely with Finance, Legal, Company Secretariat, Operations, and external banking partners to ensure treasury processes are disciplined, accurate, timely, and fit for a fast-growing AI infrastructure business.</p> <p>The role is hands-on and operationally focused, requiring strong attention to detail, control discipline, financial systems capability, and the ability to manage multiple treasury work streams across debt, hedging, cash, reporting, and intercompany activity.</p> <p>This position is ideal for someone who enjoys building robust treasury operations in a high-growth environment and can combine technical treasury knowledge with practical process execution.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Debt Facilities</span></p> <ul> <li>Maintain accurate records of debt facilities, including key terms, rate sets, interest accruals, fee amortisation, ticking fees, and related accounting inputs.</li> <li>Prepare and coordinate monthly compliance processes, covenant reporting, certificates, lender reporting, and ongoing covenant model updates.</li> <li>Coordinate treasury payments for based on debt waterfalls, and manage fees, interest, transfers to and from liquidity accounts, and other facility-related cash movements.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Cash Management &amp; Investments</span></p> <ul> <li>Prepare consolidated cash balance reporting across banking partners, including minimum cash balances required in specific accounts.</li> <li>Responsible for weekly cash flow funding and support medium term cash forecasting, incorporating expected payments, project-level requirements, liquidity needs, and corporate cash views.</li> <li>Management of short term cash investments including term deposits and MMFs.</li> <li>Support ongoing bank KYC requirements in conjunction with Company Secretariat and maintain disciplined records for bank access and authority arrangements.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Hedging</span></p> <ul> <li>Manage day-to-day FX requirements in line with weekly cash flow funding</li> <li>Support the GM Treasury in developing the Group’s hedging strategy.</li> <li>Coordinate FX and derivative confirmations and settlements.</li> <li>Support hedge accounting documentation, valuations, CVA/DVA measurement inputs, and effectiveness testing processes.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Bank Guarantees</span></p> <ul> <li>Coordinate execution, issuance, amendment, tracking, and release of bank guarantees as required by the business.</li> <li>Maintain a bank guarantee register and support accounting for guarantee fees, including upfront fees released to profit and loss over time.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Reporting, Controls &amp; Compliance</span></p> <ul> <li>Prepare monthly treasury and facility reporting, including cash balances, controlled account reconciliations, operating reporting, covenant model updates, and project-level treasury inputs.</li> <li>Support reporting required for customer contracts, lender requirements, equity investor requirements, and SPV funding arrangements.</li> <li>Prepare monthly counterparty credit reporting covering investments, mark-to-market positions, exposures, and treasury counterparty risk.</li> <li>Assist with audit reporting on treasury control and process compliance, including bank platform access reviews and segregation of duties.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">In</span></span><span style="text-decoration: underline;">tercompany &amp; Treasury Systems</span></p> <ul> <li>Support accounting and reporting for cross-entity bank transfers, cross-border balances, and ring-fenced entity balances.</li> <li>Lead or support treasury management system implementation, including facility capture, hedging workflows, valuation and effectiveness testing setup, and treasury reporting.</li> <li>Work with Finance Systems to implement automated bank statements into NetSuite and the treasury management system, and support straight-through processing for AP and treasury payments.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve treasury processes, controls, documentation, automation, and reporting cadence as Firmus scales.<strong>&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <h3 class="p1">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h3> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Required Skills</span></p> <ul> <li>8-10+ years experience in treasury operations, corporate treasury, project finance operations, banking, or a related finance role.</li> <li>Strong understanding of debt facility administration, cash management, payments, bank accounts, covenants, interest accruals, fees, and treasury reporting.</li> <li>Working knowledge of FX, derivatives, confirmations, settlements, hedge accounting support, valuations, and treasury counterparty reporting.</li> <li>Strong financial systems capability, with experience using ERP, banking platforms, treasury management systems, payment automation and AI tools.</li> <li>High attention to detail, strong control mindset, and ability to manage deadlines across multiple workstreams.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, with ability to coordinate effectively across Finance, Legal, CoSec, banks, advisors, and internal stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Preferred Experience</span></p> <ul> <li>Experience in a high-growth infrastructure, technology, energy, data centre, project finance, or listed-company environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with lender reporting, covenant models, controlled accounts, liquidity requirements and intercompany funding.</li> </ul> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Location &amp; Reporting</strong></h3> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">Location:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> Sydney, Australia</span></li> <li class="li1">Reports to:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> General Manager, Treasure</span></li> </ul> <h3 class="p1">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Employment Basis</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Permanent full-time</p> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Diversity</strong></h3> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.</p> <p class="p1">Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></p> <p class="p1">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.</p> <p class="p1">Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></p> <p class="p1">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p class="p1">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></p> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.</p> <p class="p1">What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.</p> <p class="p1">Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. raw.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Training - UK
raw.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details: https://www.loom.com/share/b0d1b0bf24c44ae8b95dca84b9db60e5

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

• Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

• Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)

• Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

• Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

• Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

• Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

• Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

• Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python

• Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor

• Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

• Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line

• Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement

• Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

• High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

• Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

• Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

• Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well

• Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat

• Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

Introduce performance and load testing for our core applications. Work with product managers so acceptance criteria are testable before build starts, and so testing time is part of every estimate. Track a small set of quality measures, such as escaped defects, change failure rate, suite run time and flake rate, and use them to decide where to invest next. Evidence of raising quality through other people, whether by coaching developers, setting standards or leading a quality practice. Visual regression or accessibility testing. Experience in a regulated industry such as iGaming, fintech or health. What you'll do

  • Make CI feedback fast and trustworthy.

  • Bring our existing end-to-end suite to a healthy state and keep it there as the new platform grows.

  • Coach developers to write and own tests for their own code, through pairing, code review and clear examples.

  • Set up test data and environments that let teams test realistically and safely.

  • Introduce performance and load testing for our core applications.

  • Work with product managers so acceptance criteria are testable before build starts, and so testing time is part of every estimate.

  • Track a small set of quality measures, such as escaped defects, change failure rate, suite run time and flake rate, and use them to decide where to invest next.

About you

  • Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript, with test code written to the same standard as production code.

  • Deep experience with a modern browser automation framework. Playwright is ideal; Cypress experience transfers well (we’re in the process of migrating from Cypress to Playwright).

  • A track record of designing test strategy across the full testing pyramid for web products and APIs, including judging where automation earns its keep.

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions ideally) with Docker, and fixing pipelines that are slow or unreliable.

  • Evidence of raising quality through other people, whether by coaching developers, setting standards or leading a quality practice.

Nice to have

  • Contract testing in a service-based architecture, for example with Pact.

  • Performance and load testing with k6, Artillery or similar.

  • Using AI coding assistants to speed up writing and maintaining tests, with the judgement to review what they produce.

  • Using observability data and production signals to decide what to test.

  • Visual regression or accessibility testing.

  • Experience in a regulated industry such as iGaming, fintech or health.

How you work

  • You explain quality trade-offs to product managers and business stakeholders in plain terms.

To help fuel that growth, we need a Motor Claims Intervention Handler to join our Claims UK team.   The main objective of this role is to contact non-fault third parties immediately following an accident to offer direct services—such as replacement vehicles, vehicle repair, or personal injury management—before the third party instructs a credit hire company or solicitor.   Excited to make an impact? Here are the details What you'll do 1. Proactive Third-Party Capture & Negotiation Review incoming first-notification-of-loss (FNOL) claims daily to identify actionable third-party capture opportunities. Make immediate outbound contact with third parties (via telephone, SMS, or email) to offer company-backed repair services and mobility solutions. Negotiate direct settlements for vehicle damage, minor injury, and loss of use while maintaining cost-control benchmarks. 2. Liability & Coverage Assessment Review accident details, police reports, dashcam footage, and policy terms to quickly determine liability percentage and fault. Determine when full liability should be admitted to secure third-party capture versus when liability should be repudiated or split. 3. Cost Mitigation & Credit Hire Prevention Actively monitor and challenge third-party credit hire, credit repair, and storage costs. Ensure all mitigation offers conform to relevant industry frameworks (such as the ABI General Terms of Agreement - GTA). Instruct approved repair networks, engineers, and hire suppliers quickly to minimize hire duration. 4. File Management & Compliance Maintain accurate, up-to-date claim notes and financial reserves on the claims management system. Ensure all communications and settlements comply with regulatory bodies (FCA, PRA, Data Protection/GDPR). Strong telephone presence with the ability to build rapport quickly and convince non-fault drivers to accept direct services. Understanding of motor liability, negligence, the Road Traffic Act, and credit hire principles/case law. Clear understanding of claim indemnity spend and financial indemnity principles. Ability to handle stressed or hostile callers with tact and professionalism. Capacity to manage a high-volume desk with rapid SLAs for outbound contact.   • Make immediate outbound contact with third parties (via telephone, SMS, or email) to offer company-backed repair services and mobility solutions.

  • Negotiate direct settlements for vehicle damage, minor injury, and loss of use while maintaining cost-control benchmarks.

    • 2. Liability & Coverage Assessment

  • Review accident details, police reports, dashcam footage, and policy terms to quickly determine liability percentage and fault.

  • Determine when full liability should be admitted to secure third-party capture versus when liability should be repudiated or split.

    • 3. Cost Mitigation & Credit Hire Prevention

  • Actively monitor and challenge third-party credit hire, credit repair, and storage costs.

  • Ensure all mitigation offers conform to relevant industry frameworks (such as the ABI General Terms of Agreement - GTA).

  • Instruct approved repair networks, engineers, and hire suppliers quickly to minimize hire duration.

    • 4. File Management & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date claim notes and financial reserves on the claims management system.

  • Ensure all communications and settlements comply with regulatory bodies (FCA, PRA, Data Protection/GDPR).

  • Recognize indicators of potential fraud or exaggerated claims and escalate them to the Counter-Fraud / Special Investigation Unit (SIU).

    •  

    What we’re looking for

  • 1-3+ years in motor claims handling (First-Notification-of-Loss, Third-Party Claims, or Credit Hire mitigation preferred).

  • A-Levels or Cert CII (Chartered Insurance Institute) qualification is desirable.

  • Strong telephone presence with the ability to build rapport quickly and convince non-fault drivers to accept direct services.

  • Understanding of motor liability, negligence, the Road Traffic Act, and credit hire principles/case law.

  • Clear understanding of claim indemnity spend and financial indemnity principles.

  • Ability to handle stressed or hostile callers with tact and professionalism.

  • Capacity to manage a high-volume desk with rapid SLAs for outbound contact.

system-wide SLIs/SLOs, capacity planning, autoscaling strategies, and mentoring senior and mid-level engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct open-source or production title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as&nbsp;<a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and&nbsp;<a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us.&nbsp;</p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£70,000 - £105,000 +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a> |</p> <p>We’re looking for&nbsp;<em>several</em><strong> Senior Product Marketing Managers </strong>to own Product Marketing for some of Monzo's most important products across Core Banking, Borrowing and Wealth</p> <p>At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers, and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign &amp; channel strategy, creative direction, and overall go-to-market approach to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we build the right products and drive their growth. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.</p> <p><strong>This is a senior individual contributor role.</strong> You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market. There are two levels of seniority available — we will determine together what best fits you during the interview process.</p> <p><strong>Where you could join:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Core </strong>is the foundation of Monzo. It's where we build the products millions of people use every day: from Current Accounts and Joint Accounts to Pots, Subscriptions, Savings Challenge, and all the moments that make managing money feel effortless. This is a role for someone who believes the best product experiences come from getting the fundamentals right, and wants to shape products that become part of people's daily lives.</li> <li><strong>Borrowing</strong> is helping customers access credit simply, transparently, and responsibly. Today that includes growing products like Flex, Loans, Credit Insights, Mortgages, and Overdrafts in the UK, while also taking Monzo's Flex proposition to millions more customers across Europe. This is a role for someone excited by the challenge of growing an established proposition at home while shaping how it succeeds in new markets; understanding local customer needs, refining the proposition, and helping build the foundations for Monzo to win internationally.</li> <li><strong>Wealth </strong>is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work and make growing money feel simpler, more accessible, and more rewarding for everyday customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own Product Marketing for a Product. </strong>You'll define a 2–4 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You'll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You'll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.</li> <li><strong>Become the expert on your market. </strong>You'll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You'll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.</li> <li><strong>Define positioning customers understand. </strong>You'll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.</li> <li><strong>Influence Product Strategy.&nbsp;</strong>You'll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you'll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.</li> <li><strong>Shape successful launches. </strong>You'll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You'll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.</li> <li><strong>Measure what matters. </strong>You'll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You'll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This is for you if:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You enjoy owning entire products.</strong> You're comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>You solve ambiguous problems with evidence.</strong> You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.</li> <li><strong>You know what makes products win.</strong> You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.</li> <li><strong>You influence through collaboration.</strong> You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.</li> <li><strong>You're always improving and helping others improve.</strong> You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (30mins)&nbsp;</li> <li>Case Study Presentation (45mins)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!&nbsp;</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to ----- You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>£70,000 - £105,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK&nbsp;</li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences&nbsp;</li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"><strong>here</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.&nbsp;<br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About 1st Formations

At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run, and grow their businesses with confidence.

Running a business shouldn't be slowed down by company formation, statutory compliance, accounting, or payroll. From day one, these essentials should be seamless, reliable, and intelligently handled, freeing founders to focus on building and scaling.

We're a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience.

No stitched-together services.

No legacy workflows disguised as software.

Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence.

Why Join Us Now?

You'll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression.

  • £18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR

  • Over 1 million companies formed

  • Certified B Corp and Carbon Neutral Business

  • Forecast to grow 5x–10x over the next three years

The Role

We're looking for an experienced, fully qualified Accountant to join our Accountancy-as-a-Service (AaaS) team, reporting to the Head of Accountancy. You'll manage a portfolio of SME, startup and owner-managed clients, delivering accurate, timely accounts and compliance work, and acting as a trusted advisor as their businesses grow.

You might come from an accountancy practice or an in-house finance team. Either way, you'll bring the breadth of experience to handle the full range of accounting work independently, from bookkeeping review and management accounts through to year-end accounts and tax returns. You'll work closely with the wider accountancy delivery team, and your expertise will help shape how we deliver accountancy services as we scale. This is a great opportunity to take ownership in a fast-growing business, with real scope to progress as the team grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of SME, startup and owner-managed clients, acting as their main point of contact for accounting and compliance matters

  • Prepare and review year-end statutory accounts, ensuring accuracy and compliance with UK accounting standards (FRS 102 and FRS 105)

  • Prepare and review corporation tax returns, VAT returns and Self Assessment returns for directors

  • Review bookkeeping and bank reconciliations, making sure client records are accurate, complete and up to date

  • Prepare management accounts and financial reports where required, helping clients understand their performance

  • Advise clients on practical accounting and financial matters, such as profit extraction, cash flow and financial best practice

  • Support new clients during onboarding, including setting up accounting systems and processes

  • Support clients with Making Tax Digital requirements for VAT and Income Tax

  • Manage statutory deadlines across your portfolio so filings are submitted accurately and on time

  • Handle most client queries independently, escalating complex or high-risk matters to the Head of Accountancy

  • Share your knowledge with the wider team, supporting and reviewing the work of less experienced colleagues

  • Help develop internal guidance, templates and resources to support consistent, high-quality delivery across the AaaS team

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools and client education

What We Are Looking For

  • Fully qualified accountant (ACA or ACCA)

  • 5–6 years' experience in accountancy, gained in an accountancy practice or an in-house finance team

  • Strong experience preparing year-end accounts, and a working knowledge of corporation tax, VAT and personal tax as they apply to small businesses

  • Experience working with SMEs, startups or owner-managed businesses, or across a broad in-house finance function

  • A confident communicator, able to explain financial matters clearly to non-specialist business owners

  • Strong hands-on experience with Xero, plus experience with accounts production and tax software such as TaxCalc, CCH or IRIS

  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple clients, competing priorities and statutory deadlines

  • A collaborative, client-first mindset, comfortable working cross-functionally within a scaling business

What We Offer

  • £50,000–£60,000 and a comprehensive benefits package

  • Hybrid working model

  • Real opportunities for progression as the business scales

  • The chance to influence both customer experience and product development

  • A culture that values ownership, impact, and continuous learning

Equal Opportunities
1st Formations is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, criminal history, disability, or gender identity. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Commercial Manager, Global Supply Chain

We're looking for a Commercial Manager, Global Supply Chain to join our team. This is a global role spanning the DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt ecosystem, with Deliveroo as the hiring entity. This is a hybrid role based in our London office.

In this role, you'll help shape what our global supply chain looks like as DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt increasingly act as one unified company — building a highly efficient commercial approach to how physical goods, logistics, and courier equipment move across our operations worldwide. Rather than three brands running separate playbooks, you'll help design the single commercial model that brings them together, turning fragmented regional practices into one coherent, scalable supply chain.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Global Supply Chain team, responsible for getting physical goods—courier apparel, equipment, in-store technology, and consumables—to our riders, merchants, and partners across every market. Sitting underneath the Senior Commercial Manager, you will build and execute sourcing strategies, lead complex international negotiations, and manage supplier performance across the DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt ecosystem.

 

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

 

Sourcing Strategy & Execution

  • Translate category strategies into actionable sourcing plans across warehousing, last-mile fulfilment, apparel, manufacturing, and consumables, driving consolidation across our brands.

     

  • Lead end-to-end competitive sourcing events, utilizing spend analytics, market intelligence, and total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling to secure optimal commercial outcomes.

     

  • Build and execute robust negotiation positions, focusing on unit cost, freight, duty, quality protections, and working capital impact.

     

Contract & Supplier Management

  • Own the end-to-end contracting process in partnership with Legal, maintaining a complete contract register and enforcing lifecycle obligations, renewals, and rebates.

     

  • Drive day-to-day commercial supplier management, conducting structured performance reviews, establishing operational KPIs, and managing Joint Improvement Plans.

     

  • Mitigate supply chain risk and ensure continuity of supply, establishing dual-sourcing strategies, financial risk assessments, and strict ethical sourcing/modern slavery compliance across manufacturing partners.

     

  • Partner with operational and logistics leadership to align requirements, streamline specifications, and build credibility across historically independent regional teams.

     

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience in supply chain sourcing, with a proven track record delivering measurable commercial value across logistics, 3PL, or manufactured goods categories.

     

  • Demonstrated ability in end-to-end competitive sourcing, including hands-on contract negotiation with major international suppliers and manufacturing partners.

     

  • Proven capability in supplier relationship and performance management, with experience handling complex commercial disputes and driving joint innovation.

     

  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with expertise in total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling, landed cost structures, and spend analytics.

     

  • Exceptional stakeholder influence, with the ability to bridge operational needs with commercial outcomes across multi-region or cross-brand environments.

     

Nice to Have

  • Experience sourcing apparel or hardgoods manufacturing, including factory selection, quality control, and ethical audit frameworks.

     

  • Experience leading post-acquisition supplier consolidation or specification harmonisation.

     

  • Familiarity with direct/inventory-based supply chains, including international freight, customs/duty, and working capital dynamics.

     

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

 

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

 

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

 

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

 

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

 

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

 

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

 

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

raw.title: Tax Compliance Manager
raw.description:
About Us

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fueling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

The Role

We're hiring a Tax Compliance Manager to take ownership of tax compliance and reporting across our growing global entity structure. This role is based in our New York City office.

You'll work closely with external advisors, finance colleagues, and cross-functional teams to ensure our compliance obligations are met to a high standard across all jurisdictions, while supporting the wider tax team on new market launches, product rollouts, and planning projects as the business scales.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone looking to own tax compliance in a fast-scaling fintech — gaining broad exposure across a range of countries and entity types, working directly with senior stakeholders, and building a deep understanding of how tax supports a business as it grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Global Tax Compliance: Manage end-to-end tax filings across all group entities, coordinating with external advisors to ensure accurate, timely returns in every jurisdiction.

  • Manage Outsourced Providers: Own the relationship with third-party compliance providers — setting scopes, reviewing deliverables, and holding quality standards across regions.

  • Lead Tax Reporting: Support the preparation of tax provisions, deferred tax calculations, and disclosures for statutory accounts and group reporting (IFRS and/or US GAAP).

  • Support New Market Launches: Ensure tax compliance requirements are embedded from day one whenever the business enters a new market or launches a new product.

  • Contribute to Tax Projects: Work alongside the wider tax team on transfer pricing documentation, group restructurings, and assessments of legislative change.

  • Build Better Processes: Develop and improve internal tax controls, reporting, and processes as the function matures and the entity structure grows.

  • Stay Ahead of Tax Developments: Monitor changes in key jurisdictions and feed these into the team's wider planning.

  • Liaise with Auditors & Tax Authorities: Act as a key point of contact for external auditors, tax authorities, and advisors on compliance queries, audits, and ad-hoc filings.

  • Monitor Effective Tax Rates: Prepare and maintain current and deferred tax reconciliations, tracking effective tax rates across the group.

What We're Looking For

  • Qualified CPA, or equivalent professional qualification.

  • At least 5 years of relevant tax experience, whether in practice (Big 4 or mid-tier) or a combination of practice and in-house.

  • Strong grounding in corporate tax compliance and reporting, with exposure to international or multi-jurisdictional work.

  • Comfortable managing external advisors and reviewing outsourced deliverables to a high standard.

  • Solid understanding of tax accounting and provisioning under US GAAP and/or IFRS — both is a plus; one is required.

  • Experience with transfer pricing compliance or documentation is a plus, but not essential.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or a high-growth startup environment is a plus.

Who You Are

  • Ownership mindset — you take responsibility, follow through, and move things forward without heavy oversight.

  • Communication — you explain tax matters clearly to non-specialists and know how to land a complex point simply.

  • Comfort with ambiguity — you make practical recommendations even when the answer isn't clear-cut.

  • Curiosity — you have a genuine interest in how tax supports a fast-growing, international business.

  • Collaborative — you work well across teams and build relationships easily.

Taptap Values 

Impact first

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

As Head of Financial Controller, you will own the full accounting function across Filigran's entities, including revenue recognition, consolidation, monthly and year-end close, and internal controls. You will act as the finance function's technical backbone building the infrastructure, controls, and processes needed to support a fast-scaling, multi-entity, international organization.

You will report directly to the VP of Finance. The team is small so this role demands both strategic ownership and significant hands-on execution.

  • Own the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all financial transactions across Filigran entities

  • Continuously improve a scalable monthly/quarterly close process

  • Ensure revenue recognition is correctly applied and documented

Multi-Entity Oversight

  • Lead consolidation across Filigran's growing international entity structure (including new entity set-ups as the company expands)

  • Partner with the VP of Finance on transfer pricing, inter company transactions, and cross-border compliance matters

Controls, Risk & Governance

  • Perform ongoing gap analyses of accounting processes and proactively design and implement internal controls and policies

  • Manage the yearly financial audit end-to-end, acting as the primary point of contact for auditors

  • Own the relationship with the external accounting firm, holding them to a high standard of accuracy and responsiveness

Systems & Scalability

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting workflows

  • Build documentation that make the accounting function auditable and transferable

Leadership & Cross-Functional Support

  • Act as a thought partner to the VP of Finance on technical accounting matters and process design

  • Manage a current team of 3 general accountants.

  • Grow the team to help support scalability and growth.

  • Support ad hoc business requests, including finance topics adjacent to accounting (e.g., payroll coordination)

🔎 Preferred Experience

  • 10+ years in accounting roles, including senior/lead or controller-level experience

  • Strong knowledge of French accounting standards; exposure to multi-GAAP/consolidation environments is a strong plus

  • Proven ability to build processes and internal controls from scratch in a fast-growing or scaling environment

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy and ambiguity; adapts quickly to change

  • Prior people management experience

Rattaché.e à la Directrice des Relations Sociales, et en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles, tu seras le garde-fou juridique capable de passer à l'action très rapidement dès que le feu vert est donné. description: <p>Dans le cadre de l’ouverture d’un poste en CDI, nous recrutons un.e <strong>AI engineer</strong>, basé-e au choix à Paris.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p>🚀 CONTEXTE &amp; ENJEUX STRATÉGIQUES</p> <p>Au sein de Decathlon Digital, l'équipe People Data engage une initiative majeure : transformer l'expérience de nos 100 000 collaborateurs par l'intégration de l'IA Générative et Agentique.</p> <p>Face à la fragmentation de l'écosystème RH dans plus de 70 pays, notre ambition est de construire une couche de simplification en s’appuyant sur les nouvelles solutions que proposent l’IA. Il s'agit d'une couche d'intelligence centralisée et agnostique des outils, capable d'interagir avec l'ensemble de notre infrastructure (Workday, Data Lake, University, ...) pour faire évoluer nos interfaces d'une logique de consultation vers une logique d'action.</p> <p>Dans ce cadre, nous développons <strong>DaiLY</strong>, notre agent conversationnel RH. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers à accéder instantanément à une information fiable, sourcée à partir de notre documentation Workday et de nos politiques People.</p> <p>Déjà déployé avec succès en France, DaiLY entre dans une nouvelle phase de passage à l'échelle : extension internationale, industrialisation des évaluations, amélioration continue de nos modèles et de leurs qualités et déploiement et intégration d’agents autonomes RH.&nbsp;</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p>Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e développeur.se, nous avons besoin d'un.e "<strong>Builder</strong>" : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin métier en solution technique, de l’implémenter, la qualifier, la déployer et la maintenir dans le temps.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p>&nbsp;🎯 VOTRE MISSION</p> <p>Nous recherchons un(e) <strong>AI Engineer confirmé(e)</strong> pour participer activement à l'industrialisation et au développement de DaiLY. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins métiers RH en fonctionnalités IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.</p> <p>Pour relever ce défi, vous évoluerez au <strong>sein d'un collectif dédié</strong>, en collaboration directe avec d'autres AI Engineers, un Lead AI Engineer (qui orientera les choix d'architecture globale) et une Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximité vous permettra d'assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l'implémentation technique.</p> <p>Vous aurez notamment un rôle clé dans l'évolution de DaiLY : passer d'un modèle de simple consultation (Q&amp;A) à un <strong>véritable système agentique transactionnel</strong> capable de déclencher des actions concrètes (ex : poser des congés dans Workday, s'inscrire à des formations via Decathlon University).</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p>🛠 VOS RESPONSABILITES&nbsp;</p> <ol> <li>Développement Agentique &amp; Fonctionnalités</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Participer à l'extension des capacités de DaiLY vers des actions d'écriture (write actions) en implémentant des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).</li> <li>Implémenter des stratégies avancées de chunking et de re-ranking pour prioriser les règles spécifiques au domaine RH.</li> <li>Contribuer à l'optimisation des coûts, de la latence et de l'efficacité globale du système en lien avec les équipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.</li> </ul> <ol> <li>Qualité, Évaluation &amp; Observabilité (LLMOps)</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Développer et maintenir la couche de qualité du pipeline RAG multi-agents (Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine).</li> <li>Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des réponses et la vérification des citations pour garantir la traçabilité vers une source de vérité.</li> <li>Mettre en place des pipelines d'observabilité robustes pour l'évaluation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow).</li> <li>Coder des évaluateurs automatiques basés sur des golden datasets pour itérer sereinement et prévenir les régressions avant chaque mise en production.</li> <li>Intégrer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour protéger le système et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.</li> </ul> <ol> <li>Sécurité, Cloisonnement &amp; Déploiement International</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Management (ACLs) : Implémenter une gestion granulaire et dynamique des droits d'accès au niveau de l'indexation et du retrieval, garantissant qu'un collaborateur n'accède strictement qu'aux documents RH de son périmètre.</li> <li>Isolation &amp; About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
 
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
 
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role overview
 
Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business.
 
Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform.
 
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact.
 
To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées.

  • Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey.
  • Collaboration  - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases.
  • Persuasion - Use consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs and requirements and have the ability to upsell and cross-sell the Fresha Platform.

  • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

  • Experience - 1-2 Years experience in effectively delivering commercial outcomes from a previous Account Management role
  • Closing Skills – Demonstrated ability to effectively close deals, negotiate, and convert opportunities
  • Adaptability - Shown to be commercially motivated with an ability to adapt and achieve targets
  • Analytics - Proven experience in using and analysing data and reporting effectively to improve commercial outcomes
  • Curiosity - Naturally proactive and inquisitive, with a desire to consistently learn and improve

Updated in September 2026

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow

 

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

 

2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.

 

3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!

 

4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃

 

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check

 

7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.

 

*****

 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. If you’re excited about what we do and feel you could contribute, we want to hear from you.

Your voice recordings will be used exclusively for the client's internal CX AI Agent. They will not be sold, licensed, or reused for any other product, dataset, or purpose.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Record high-quality voice samples across diverse scripts (conversational, narrative, instructional, etc.)
  • Deliver clear, natural, and expressive speech with strong control over tone, pacing, and pronunciation
  • Maintain consistency in voice, accent, and delivery across recording sessions
  • Follow detailed recording guidelines (environment, microphone setup, file formatting)
  • Perform multiple takes with variation in emotion, emphasis, and style when required

Requirements

  • Native Swiss German speaker currently based in Switzerland
  • A clear, natural, and expressive voice (prior voice acting, narration, or broadcast experience is a plus, not required)
  • Access to a professional or near-professional recording setup (quality microphone, quiet environment, pop filter, etc.)

  • Ability to follow scripts precisely while maintaining natural delivery

title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <h2>Main Responsibilities</h2> <p>As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge &amp; Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.</li> <li><strong>Work Experience:</strong> Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Business Acumen &amp; AI Fluency:</strong> A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.</li> <li><strong>Analytical &amp; Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.</li> <li><strong>Communication &amp; Interpersonal Skills:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred..&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Work Eligibility:</strong> You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and the Build:</strong> Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.</li> <li><strong>Engineers, not hand-offs:</strong> Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.</li> <li><strong>Zurich Office Impact:</strong> As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Learning &amp; Growth:</strong> Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Doers:</strong> Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.</li> </ul> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich or Lausanne</strong>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
